featured.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first trilateral in Shenzhen
featured.summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia meet for the first time, after separate bilaterals; nuclear arms, Ukraine and Iran top the agenda. Xi chairs at APEC.

featured.headline: GTA VI goes on sale after 13-year wait
featured.summary: Rockstar's blockbuster rolls out worldwide on PS5 and Xbox; first reviews score 99/100 and 2.3 million watch on Twitch.

featured.headline: World court rules on Myanmar Rohingya genocide case
featured.summary: The ICJ delivers its final judgment in Gambia v. Myanmar over the 2017 crackdown that drove 730,000 Rohingya to Bangladesh; no state has ever been found guilty of genocide.

featured.headline: Crimea bridge hit a third time in a week
featured.summary: An overnight strike hits the rail section and halts trains, two days after drones and missiles collapsed the road span; damage being assessed.

featured.headline: Iran hits Gulf states; Kuwait says it repelled attack
featured.summary: Kuwait says it fought off its first Iranian attack in two months; Bahrain was also targeted after Tuesday's US strike on Qeshm island.

featured.headline: EU proposes €45bn loan to keep Ukraine funded
featured.summary: Von der Leyen proposes €45bn for 2027, on top of €90bn planned, as Kyiv faces a €25bn shortfall and allies meet in Berlin.

featured.headline: Israel launches ground operation beyond Gaza 'yellow line'
featured.summary: Troops push into central Gaza to dismantle a tunnel; Hamas calls it a flagrant breach of the ceasefire.

featured.headline: Bangladesh unrest spreads as Yunus home is torched
featured.summary: Violence hits 28 districts in ten days; paramilitary deployed as Hasina's party protests her return, announced for December.

featured.headline: COP31 deadlock persists in Antalya
featured.summary: Ministers push to unblock talks on a final text as fossil-fuel phase-out splits the summit; countries launch a climate check.

featured.headline: Anthropic prices record $83 IPO
featured.summary: The AI firm prices shares at $83 in a record $81.3bn raise valuing it near $1.5tn; Asian shares still fall on AI worries.

featured.headline: Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops at border
featured.summary: Forces gather along the frontier as Tigray fighting raises fears of a wider war in the Horn of Africa.

featured.headline: M5.7 quake jolts Kumamoto; 22,000 told to flee
featured.summary: A 5.7-magnitude quake hits at 2:22 a.m.; two hurt, Minamata orders its whole city to evacuate and 8 bullet trains halt.

featured.headline: Fiji and Tonga declare drought emergencies
featured.summary: Both declare emergencies as El Niño drought parches the Pacific; Fiji cites severe water shortages.

featured.headline: Jeffries set to be first Black House Speaker
featured.summary: Democrats designate Hakeem Jeffries to lead the House, the first Black Speaker; the party holds a 254-170 majority.

featured.headline: South Korea exports pass $1 trillion
featured.summary: Exports top $1tn for the first time, driven by chip demand as the AI boom powers the economy.

featured.headline: Pochettino starts as Manchester United manager
featured.summary: Mauricio Pochettino takes over at Old Trafford as the club fights relegation.
